title: FigEx2: Visual-Conditioned Panel Detection and Captioning for Scientific Compound Figures
abstract: arXiv:2601.08026v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific compound figures combine multiple labeled panels into a single image, and downstream pretraining and retrieval require panel-aligned visual-text pairs. However, in a PubMed Central (PMC)-scale crawl of 346,567 compound figures, 16.3% have no caption and are discarded by existing caption-decomposition pipelines. We propose FigEx2, a visual-conditioned framework that takes only a compound figure as input and jointly produces labeled panel boxes and panel-wise captions. FigEx2 introduces an Entity-Attention Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularizer that aligns the detector's cross-attention with scientific entities annotated for each panel, providing a stable conditioning signal that also improves localization, and applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a panel-level Entity-F1 reward to optimize scientific faithfulness. We curate BioSci-Fig-Cap for in-domain supervision and contribute physics and chemistry test

translated_title: FigEx2：面向科学复合图的视觉条件子图检测与描述生成
translated_abstract: 科学复合图将多个带标签的子图组合成单一图像，而下游的预训练和检索任务需要对齐子图的视觉-文本对。然而，在PubMed Central（PMC）规模抓取的346,567张复合图中，16.3%的图像没有描述文本，会被现有的描述分解流程直接丢弃。我们提出了FigEx2，这是一个视觉条件框架，仅以复合图作为输入，即可同时生成带标签的子图边界框和逐子图的描述文本。FigEx2引入了实体注意力Kullback-Leibler（KL）正则化器，将检测器的交叉注意力与每个子图标注的科学实体对齐，提供稳定的条件信号并同时改善定位效果；此外还应用了组相对策略优化（GRPO），配合子图级别的实体F1奖励来优化科学忠实性。我们整理了BioSci-Fig-Cap数据集用于领域内监督，并贡献了物理和化学测试（集）……
tldr: FigEx2提出了一种仅以科学复合图为输入的视觉条件框架，通过实体注意力KL正则化和GRPO强化学习联合完成子图检测与描述生成，有效解决了大规模文献中约16.3%无描述复合图被丢弃的问题。
en_tdlr: FigEx2 is a visual-conditioned framework that jointly detects labeled panels and generates panel-wise captions from compound figures alone, leveraging an Entity-Attention KL regularizer and GRPO with Entity-F1 rewards to address the 16.3% of caption-less compound figures discarded by existing pipelines.
